verdict.rationale: HumanLayer's workflow-phases and skills-workflows docs describe selecting review-heavy paths (RPI, PRD-Oriented) where 'a change with unclear behavior or code shape needs more review before implementation,' implying a pre-implementation approval gate, and community feedback confirms leads value approving AI changes before autonomous execution. However, there is no explicit documentation of a formal 'scope/contract sign-off' artifact or hard gate that blocks repository modification until an engineering lead approves it. Missing for 10: explicit scope/contract approval artifact, evidence of an enforced blocking gate before any file/repo write, and independent confirmation the gate is mandatory rather than optional.
